findings.title: Timed-out releases can outlive their claims and invalidate a subsequent seal
findings.detail: FIXED. Every claimed release now sends its generation and metageneration preconditions. Lines 100–110 re-observe a failed precondition and require a successful claim rebase before releasing a newer incarnation. packages/persistence/src/source/holds.ts:259 restricts rebasing to the object's latest unanswered live claim; packages/persistence/migrations/0020_source_object_holds.sql:342 independently enforces those restrictions. Both control-plane releases (apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:110) and failed-seal cleanup (packages/application/src/sources/handlers/seal-revision.ts:494) use this helper. The storage fake increments metageneration on placement at packages/application/src/testing/contract-fake-object-storage.ts:535 and checks it before clearing the hold at :551. The exact prior reproduction is covered at apps/control/test/seal-holds.test.ts:602: assertions at :657–663 establish that the delayed release fails, overwrite is refused and the seal commits the live held generation. verify.log:678 records its pass; :679 and :537 record the precondition-recovery and database-guard regressions. Actual provider qualification remains explicitly deferred to B15.
findings.reproduction: The regression pauses a failed seal's cleanup release until its default timeout, advances both database clocks 960 seconds beyond the claim's 910-second in-flight bound, completes a retry, pauses a new seal before commit, then resumes the original release and attempts overwrite. The original release returns PRECONDITION_FAILED; the newer hold survives and overwrite returns OBJECT_HELD.

findings.title: Excluded hidden columns remain excluded from projection counts

findings.title: Lapsed unresolved cancellation secrets remain discoverable and purged
findings.detail: FIXED. Agency-paged discovery finds lapsed cancellation secrets and invokes cleanup at line 66. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:246–248 purges the secret after its horizon without claiming cancellation confirmation or calling the provider. apps/control/test/storage-lifecycle.test.ts:333–352 checks retained UNCERTAIN status, secret removal, no additional provider call and pagination past cleaned agencies. verify.log:683 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: An unresolved cancellation retains its secret before expiry, loses it on the post-horizon sweep, and does not prevent discovery of a later agency's remaining secret.
